usdt.note: Official public rate fields; not personal account return, executable borrow allowance or approved collateral LTV. No additional 15% deducted from the published lendingRate.

usdc.note: Official public rate fields; not personal account return, executable borrow allowance or approved collateral LTV. No additional 15% deducted from the published lendingRate.

borrow_short_term.note: Cost illustration only; excludes fees and loan eligibility.

collateral_gap.note: Hypothetical failed/late liquidation, ignores interest/fees; not actual default probability or normal liquidation trigger.

borrow_low_lend_high.note: Not an available product quote. Collateral yield assumed zero solely for arithmetic; all fees, changing rates, liquidation and platform losses excluded.

loss_vs_interest.note: Stress example, not an estimate of event likelihood or expected loss.
